title: Script table construction
summary: Recover 0x4f0900 allocation, GC-list insertion, white-bit initialization and ordered array/hash helper calls as a portable State member. Preserve allocator-induced global replacement and the untouched +0x18 field.
test_description: 6144 direct original/source comparisons: array counts 0,1,2,7,31,63; every white byte; null/non-null zero-sized allocator return; allocator replacement of state.global. Assert result identity, complete table/state/global bytes, wrapping allocation accounting, callback ordering/arguments, array tags and untouched payloads/storage. Another 36 source-only dependency-boundary cases check signed extreme capacities and unchanged forwarding to helpers.
known_limits: Original custom ECX/EDX/caller-cleaned stack ABI is represented only in GCC test adapters; implementation is a portable state member, not byte-matched.

Direct oracle tests use hash count zero. Positive hash initialization requires original logarithm bytes at 0x99a438, not provided by an assigned qualified data fixture. Arbitrary hash counts are checked only at the source dependency boundary.
Allocation failure/nonlocal VM error paths, invalid capacities inside dependencies, and allocator internals are not tested or replaced. Accepted helpers remain explicit services.
Layouts model 32-bit VM pointers. +0x18 meaning remains unresolved and is preserved; no full-game or rendering claim.
